evidence_snippets: G4 machine types G4 accelerator-optimized machine types use NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs ( nvidia-rtx-pro-6000 ) and are suitable for NVIDIA Omniverse simulation workloads, graphics-intensive applications, video transcoding, and virtual desktops.
